(codec_head = Linear(1024,3072,bias=False), :1579); the 15 per-depth microdecoder heads are 2048 wide.
Stop detection is codec_eos_token_id = 2150 on the TALKER head only. Talker control ids from
config.json: pad 2148, bos 2149, eos 2150, think 2154, nothink 2155, think_bos 2156, think_eos 2157,
and language ids english 2050 german 2053 spanish 2054 chinese 2055 japanese 2058 french 2061
korean 2064 russian 2069 italian 2070 portuguese 2071.

Third trap for the canonical-greedy ladder: max_new_tokens has THREE different upstream values —
generation_config.json 8192, qwen3_tts_model.py:2031 default 4096, README eval 2048 (gh/README.md:465).
Detail: docs/truth-pack/FACT_DISPOSITIONS.md (E-2, E-4)

title: [P1] Talker forward (mRoPE/GQA/SwiGLU) teacher-forced parity
description:
[P1] Talker forward (28 layers, mRoPE, GQA, SwiGLU) — teacher-forced parity per layer.

WHAT: the talker in safe Rust over the BF16 accessors: embedding pipeline (cold text rows + projection; audio/conditioning tokens per spec); 28 identical layers — RMSNorm -> QKV (1024->2048/1024/1024) -> QK-Norm if OQ-3 confirms -> mRoPE (theta 1e6, interleaved multimodal sections [24,20,20], 3-D position ids per OQ-4's schedule) -> GQA attention (16Q/8KV, head_dim 128, causal, growing KV cache preallocated from census) -> O-proj (2048->1024) -> residual; RMSNorm -> gate/up (1024->3072) -> SiLU-gated -> down (3072->1024) -> residual; final norm + primary-code head.

PARITY METHOD (seam-ordered, the skill's Phase-1 discipline): feed each Rust stage the ORACLE'S EXACT INPUT tensor (decouples stages); per-layer cosine ~1.0 + max-abs ledgered vs teacher-forced fixtures; then first-frame primary-code argmax EXACT; attribute every residual to a named cause, never hand-wave.

DONE WHEN: all 28 layers pass L1/L2 vs fixtures within floor-derived tolerances; first-token argmax exact; KV cache correctness (cached==uncached) proven; unit tests per sub-op with logging.

title: [P1] Sequential 15-step microdecoder (authoritative baseline)
description:
[P1] Sequential 15-step microdecoder forward (the honest baseline) — teacher-forced parity per depth.

WHAT: the Residual-Code Microdecoder exactly as the official inference path runs it: after the talker samples the primary code, RESET the tiny KV state, then for residual_depth 0..14: embed the previous token with the DEPTH-SPECIFIC embedding -> 5-layer forward (1024-wide geometry, plain RoPE via apply_rotary_pos_emb semantics — a DIFFERENT rotary kernel than the talker's mRoPE) -> the DEPTH-SPECIFIC 2048-way head -> sample -> feed forward. The frame sequence is 1 conditioning/primary position + 15 residual positions = 16; each sampled residual conditions the NEXT depth (autoregressively dependent — any "depths are independent" shortcut is invalid, ledgered as such).

WHY THIS EXACT SHAPE MATTERS: this sequential loop is the AUTHORITATIVE baseline that every later lever (hot-packed engine, FrankenMTP, Q4 depths) must match bit-for-bit (greedy) or distributionally (sampled). Getting the conditioning inputs per depth right (OQ-5) is the single most dangerous correctness surface in the project.

PARITY: teacher-forced logits per depth vs oracle fixtures (all 15 depths); greedy full-frame code ids EXACT vs oracle canonical-greedy; KV-reset semantics verified (frame N cannot see frame N-1's microdecoder KV).

DONE WHEN: all 15 depths pass fixture parity; full-frame greedy ids exact over the golden corpus prefix the oracle reproduces; per-depth unit tests with logging.

title: [P1] Codec decoder (streaming+offline, ring buffers, stream==batch gate)
description:
[P1] Codec decoder: streaming + offline, ring buffers, exact geometry.

WHAT: the speech-tokenizer decoder in safe Rust: RVQ embedding sums over the 16 code groups (high-precision codebooks); 8 transformer-like layers (hidden 512, intermediate 1024, 16 heads x head_dim 64 — attention width 1024 = 2x hidden — sliding window 72); causal convs with STATEFUL RING BUFFERS sized from OQ-7's receptive fields; upsampling [8,5,4,3] to 1920 samples per frame at 24 kHz, written STREAMING into the output PCM buffer (no re-decode of past audio). Both drive modes: offline (whole token stream) and streaming (packet-at-a-time with persistent state).

THE STANDING GATE (from day one, not retrofitted): streaming == offline decode of the same token stream, BIT-IDENTICAL target (same ops, same order — chunking must not change arithmetic); any divergence is a ledgered DISC, never silent. Plus packet-1 == packet-4 equality for the same tokens.

DONE WHEN: block-level fixture parity vs oracle (per-block activations); waveform within floor-derived tolerance of oracle decode of the SAME tokens; streaming==offline green across chunk-boundary fuzz schedules; ring-buffer state unit tests with logging.

title: [P1] ECAPA speaker encoder + conditioning injection
description:
[P1] ECAPA speaker encoder (x-vector path).

WHAT: the ECAPA-TDNN speaker encoder in safe Rust: 128-mel front end (exact parameters per OQ-9, shared with the audio bead's STFT/mel), dilated Conv1d stack (channels [512,512,512,512,1536], kernels [5,3,3,3,1], dilations [1,2,3,4,1]), SE blocks + attentive statistics pooling per the pinned source, 1024-d output embedding; plus the conditioning INJECTION into the talker per OQ-9's documented mechanism.

WHY: this is the entire "quick" cloning path (drop in a WAV, no transcript) — embedding parity decides whether quick-enrolled voices sound like the speaker. Enrollment-only: lives behind the enrollment build split (ordinary synthesis artifacts need not carry it).

DONE WHEN: embedding cosine vs oracle ~1.0 (within measured floor) over the golden references; injected-state fixtures match; unit tests per block; mel-front-end differential test shared with the audio bead green.

title: [P1] Codec encoder (ICL reference tokens, exact)
description:
[P1] Codec encoder (ICL enrollment path).

WHAT: the speech-tokenizer ENCODER (geometry per OQ-7) in safe Rust: reference audio -> codec tokens for ICL prompt construction. Enrollment-only (behind the encode-capable artifact section / --with-enrollment); ordinary synthesis never carries it.

WHY: the ICL path is the QUALITY cloning path (upstream documents x-vector-only as potentially lower quality); its fidelity depends on encoding the reference exactly as the official stack does — token mismatches here poison the prompt and thus everything downstream of enrollment.

DONE WHEN: encoded reference tokens EXACT vs oracle over golden references (discrete artifact -> exact comparison is possible and required); quantizer-assignment unit tests; round-trip sanity (encode->decode audibly reconstructs; content metric vs reference roundtrip).

title: [P1] End-to-end assembly + ConformanceExact all-green (exit gate)
description:
[P1] End-to-end assembly: ConformanceExact green (the Phase-1 exit gate).

WHAT: wire the full pipeline — text (verbatim normalize -> tokenize -> prompt assembly) -> prefill (cold-row embedding + projection -> talker KV) -> per-frame nested decode (talker -> primary -> KV reset -> 15x microdecoder -> 16-code frame) -> streaming codec -> PCM out — through the TtsEngine shell (budgets, cancellation, observer, robot events), both clone modes, canonical-greedy and sampled paths.

EXIT LADDER (Contract A, tolerances from the committed nondeterminism floor): L0 front-end exact -> L1 per-op -> L2 per-layer/depth/block -> L3 logits (argmax exact where oracle reproduces itself) -> L4 full codec-token stream exact under canonical greedy over the oracle-reproducible prefix -> L5 audio per the pre-committed OQ-12 fork. PLUS: streaming==batch; determinism (same text+voice+seed+artifact+build -> byte-identical PCM in strict mode); cached==uncached; both clone modes reference-matching; the many_utterances watchdog green.

CLI-LEVEL E2E (not just engine-level): a scripted end-to-end test that SPAWNS THE REAL BINARIES — ftts say (human mode -> WAV validated: header, sample count, content hash), ftts say --robot (NDJSON parsed + schema-validated event-by-event), ftts say --stream raw (PCM on stdout + events on stderr, both consumed concurrently), ftts enroll -> ftts say --voice round trip — with detailed structured logging at every step so failures localize instantly. This is the script the release smoke test reuses.

WHY ITS OWN BEAD: seam-passing stages can still fail assembled (stage-boundary bugs, state leaks across utterances, budget/cancel interactions); the e2e gate is where "the whole forward is correct" becomes a claim with a receipt.

DONE WHEN: one-command ladder receipt all-green (skip-honest); CLI e2e script green in CI (model-gated); e2e golden runs committed; the Phase-1 exit announced with its equivalence-tier statement.

title: [VER] ConformanceExact ladder runner (skip-honest receipts)
description:
[VER] Contract A harness: the ConformanceExact ladder runner.

WHAT: the reusable harness in ftts-conformance implementing Contract A: seam comparators (cosine + max-abs + fingerprints) reading tolerances FROM the committed nondeterminism-floor artifact (never constants — silent epsilon bumps are a ledgered, gated operator, not an edit); teacher-forced runners for talker layers, all 15 microdecoder depths, codec blocks, ECAPA; canonical-greedy generation compare; the one-command ladder scorecard with SKIP-HONEST receipts (skipped-with-reason is distinct from green; XFAIL never SKIP; forced all_green=false when anything skipped); EngineIdentity::{Subject,Oracle} asserted-distinct so the oracle is never compared against itself; the comparator bridge is test-only, NEVER linked into the shipping binary (G3's no-foreign-runtime claim).

WHY A SEPARATE BEAD (policy: implementation beads own their tests; SEPARATE beads only for independently reusable infrastructure): every Phase-1 component bead, every Phase-2 quant lever, and every Phase-3 kernel re-proves through THIS harness — it is the single most reused artifact in the project.

DONE WHEN: harness runs against Phase-1 components; receipt format documented + stable; ladder receipts land in evidence dirs with SHA-256 manifests.

title: [VER] ProductionQuality harness (distributional + free-running)
description:
[VER] Contract B harness: ProductionQuality metrics.

WHAT: the distributional + free-running quality harness: TEACHER-FORCED distributional metrics (per-level per-depth logit KL/JS divergence, top-k set overlap, reference rank of selected token, first-divergence position distributions) and FREE-RUNNING metrics under the production sampler (ASR-scored WER via pinned eval-side scorers — never linked into ftts; repeated/skipped-word rate; stop-token errors; speaker-identity scores with MULTIPLE unrelated embedding encoders, explicitly SECONDARY to human listening; prosody measures; long-form drift metric — the distinct-regime gate motivated by the paper's 25Hz-beats-12Hz long-speech result). Free-running comparisons are DISTRIBUTION-LEVEL BY DESIGN: many seeds x paired texts, rank statistics + equivalence bounds — never single-seed A/B (we do not replicate torch's RNG stream; standing DISC).

WHY: Contract B is the INT8/lever shipping gate (full token equality is only a diagnostic there); model surgery later needs surgery-specific canaries (high-frequency loss, identity, sibilance under shallow residual depth) which plug in here.

DONE WHEN: harness computes all metric families over the golden corpus; CI-nightly objective-proxy subset wired; report format feeds the release scorecard.
notes: POLISH R3: the harness itself must be self-tested — each metric implementation (KL/JS, top-k overlap, reference rank, WER pipeline, drift metric) validated against hand-computed reference values on synthetic distributions before it may gate anything; a metric harness with a bug silently green-lights broken levers.

title: [VER] Listening protocol operationalized (ABX/TOST/margins/owners)
description:
[VER] The operationalized listening protocol (docs/CONFORMANCE_AND_LISTENING.md).

WHAT: the human-evaluation apparatus, OPERATIONALIZED BEFORE FIRST USE (otherwise the boldest quality machinery cannot actually gate a lever): ABX speaker-identity tests (reference A; candidates B/C) + pairwise/MUSHRA-style naturalness; PREDEFINED smallest effect size of interest + TOST equivalence margins PER METRIC FAMILY (we demonstrate equivalence, never mistake failure-to-reject for it); hierarchical analysis over speaker/text/language/listener; tail reporting on the canary axes (noisy references, sibilants, breaths, code-switching, numbers, long form); the listener-pool recruitment plan + a NAMED OWNER for the power analysis; the AUTOMATION BOUNDARY (objective proxies run CI-nightly; human panels run at quantization gates + releases); the RELEASE BINDING (AF-2's CVaR bound is a named bit in the ship gate, not advisory).

WHY: audio claims need EARS (doctrine 8) — embedding cosine is secondary; but un-powered listening ("several hundred undifferentiated judgments") is theater. Separate protocol instances serve: model selection (bakeoff Gate A), quantization gates (Q8/Q4), enrollment preprocessing (voice compiler).

DONE WHEN: the document committed with all margins/owners/boundaries filled in; a pilot ABX run end-to-end validates the pipeline; harness scripts reusable by bakeoff + quant + enrollment beads.

title: [VER] Metamorphic invariants + golden artifacts
description:
[VER] Metamorphic invariants + golden artifacts.

WHAT — THE INVARIANT LIST (each an automated test; each optimized path carries its OWN greedy token-identity proof against sequential — per-path, not global): batch==singleton (strict mode); packet-1==packet-4 for the same codec tokens; prompt-cache==full-prefill; streaming codec==offline codec; identical voice input -> identical portable .ftvoice (hash-stable); scalar==SIMD on every tier; thread-count invariance (strict); corrupted/truncated artifacts always fail BEFORE inference; greedy FrankenMTP ids == greedy sequential ids; AF-3 alpha->0 == sequential path byte-for-byte (strict); verify-then-repair can never emit a depth sequence impossible under the training-mode causal mask.

EXPLICITLY NOT AN INVARIANT (deleted in review): "trailing punctuation must not change the spoken prefix" — punctuation legitimately alters preceding prosody in a text-conditioned AR model; that is a behavior study, not a gate.

GOLDEN ARTIFACTS: exact codec-token streams (insta-style); fuzzy/ULP logits; scrubbed robot NDJSON (timing/run-id removed); per-platform PCM content hashes (cross-BUILD outputs compare by content metric, never byte identity — LTO reorders f32); UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 with mandatory diff review; *.actual gitignored; CI never auto-updates.

DONE WHEN: all invariants implemented + wired to CI; golden inventory documented; the FrankenMTP invariants activate when 3A lands (registered now, model-gated).

title: [VER] Fuzzing (parsers, tokenizer, audio, chunk schedules)
description:
[VER] Fuzzing: artifact parsers, tokenizer, audio, text, chunk schedules.

WHAT: fuzz targets (in ftts-conformance, run in CI with a committed corpus + nightly deep runs): all four artifact parsers (.fttsq/.fttspack/.ftvoice/.ftvoice-cache — headers, offsets, overlapping ranges, truncation, bit-flips) plus .fttsdraft when it lands; tokenizer metadata + malformed UTF-8 + extreme text; WAV/FLAC decode; chunk-boundary schedules for the streaming codec (randomized packet/chunk splits must never change output — feeds streaming==batch).

WHY: the artifact parsers are the security surface of a tool that loads multi-GB binary blobs from disk; hardening acceptance criteria (checked arithmetic on every offset/length, range-overlap rejection, per-section digest verification, header size caps, no decompression without bomb limits) are CONCRETE CI gates on ftts-artifacts, not general security ceremony.

DONE WHEN: fuzz targets registered + corpus seeded; zero known crashes; hardening checklist items each covered by at least one test; CI wiring documented.

title: [VER] Reliability gates (admission, health, streaming failures)
description:
[VER] Reliability gates: admission, runtime health, streaming failure semantics.

WHAT: (a) RESOURCE ADMISSION — before synthesis, compute and validate: token count, predicted max frames (from OQ-6 stop rules + hard duration limit), KV allocation, codec state, voice-cache footprint, concurrency budget, total memory reservation; REJECT BEFORE PARTIAL ALLOCATION (never die halfway through a long generation). (b) RUNTIME HEALTH — NaN/Inf checks at configurable seams; no-progress frame watchdog; EOS/max-duration consistency; repeated-token runaway detector; output-silence detector; FALLBACK from an optimized ISA kernel to the certified scalar baseline after selftest failure; thermal-degradation reporting on sustained runs. (c) STREAMING FAILURE SEMANTICS (defined + tested): consumer stops reading -> producer parks, budget then cancels; sink write error -> drain + structured error; event-sink blocking -> audio and event channels CANNOT deadlock each other (separate bounded queues, independent shutdown); cancellation during codec emission -> finalize at frame boundary; disk-full -> partial-WAV finalization with valid header.

WHY: correctness work concentrates on numerics; production TTS dies on hostile/broken inputs and stuck consumers. admission-before-allocation is an e-process invariant in the release gauntlet.

DONE WHEN: each gate implemented + failure-injection tested with detailed logging; health events flow through SynthesisObserver/robot; documented in the reliability section of the conformance doc.

title: [VER/AF-2] CVaR/EVT tail-risk release gate
description:
[VER/AF-2] Tail-risk release gate: CVaR/EVT over WER + identity + drift.

WHAT (alien-artifact family AF-2 — consumer: the release ship gate as a NAMED BIT; deletion condition: never, while any lossy lever ships — it IS the tail gate): compute per-utterance quality metrics over the golden corpus and gate releases on the WORST alpha-fraction (CVaR) plus an EVT (generalized-Pareto) tail estimate — never the mean. TTS fails in the tail: hallucinated/repeated/skipped words, premature endings, identity drift on hard texts; a quant choice can look fine on mean-WER while wrecking sibilance-heavy or number-dense items.

MECHANICS: tail_risk_monitor emitting (mean, CVaR_alpha, EVT_p99x) per metric family; canary axes (sibilants, breaths, noisy references, code-switching, numbers, long form) reported separately; the release scorecard consumes the CVaR bound as a hard bit. Fallback (deterministic, wired first): the offending lever ships one precision tier higher or off.

DONE WHEN: monitor implemented over Contract-B outputs; thresholds set from the -1B/f32 baseline distributions; wired into the Phase-2 staged-lever gates and the Phase-7 scorecard; transparency card + assumptions ledger committed.
notes: POLISH R3: estimator self-tests required — CVaR and the EVT (generalized-Pareto) tail fit validated on synthetic distributions with KNOWN tail parameters (recovery within stated error) before thresholds are trusted; also document the sample-size floor below which the EVT fit refuses to emit a number (refusal over noise, per honesty doctrine).

title: [P2] .fttsq canonical format + hardened reader (access classes)
description:
[P2] .fttsq canonical artifact format + hardened reader.

WHAT: the immutable, PORTABLE model container: magic FTTSQ, format_version (loader refuses newer-than-binary), model_family enum, source SHA-256 provenance, license_notice (Apache-2.0 attribution — MUST be present, per OQ-1), frozen model-config copy, tensor directory (dtype/shape/offsets/inline quant scales/group metadata), per-section SHA-256 digests, ACCESS-CLASS SECTIONS: HOT_RECURRENT_MICRODECODER (~110 MB-class: body + 15 depth heads + depth embeds + scales), HOT_RECURRENT_TALKER (~440 MB), HOT_CODEC_DECODER, COLD_TEXT_EMBEDDING (~622 MB BF16 — lazy, row-granular, NEVER WILLNEEDed wholesale), ENROLLMENT_SPEAKER_ENCODER + ENROLLMENT_CODEC_ENCODER (optional, --with-enrollment), METADATA. NO machine-specific tiling (that is .fttspack's job — the split lets kernel layouts evolve without republishing GB-scale files). Additive format evolution: new fields default-omitted + unknown-value refusal + byte-identity test for old artifacts.

HARDENING (concrete CI gates): max tensor count/rank/dims; checked arithmetic on every offset/length; overlapping-range rejection; per-section digest verification; atomic temp-write + rename; truncated-file + bit-flip tests; header size caps.

DONE WHEN: reader/writer + census-on-load; hardening tests + fuzz target green; BF16 verbatim round-trip byte-identity test green; page-in policy per access class implemented.

title: [P2] Streaming converter (bounded memory, by-construction parity)
description:
[P2] Streaming bounded-memory converter (runtime quant first, byte-identical by construction).

WHAT: ftts convert: mmap/stream ONE safetensors tensor at a time -> validate against the WeightsManifest -> quantize in bounded tiles -> hash + write its canonical .fttsq section -> release -> atomically finalize the index. NEVER loads the whole BF16 model into a map widened to f32 (bounded peak memory on ordinary machines; no multi-GB transient).

ORDERING RULE (the by-construction parity trick): RUNTIME quantization ships FIRST (the engine can quantize from raw safetensors in-process); the offline converter then reuses the IDENTICAL quantizer function — so artifact-vs-runtime parity is byte-identical BY CONSTRUCTION, plus a test asserting it. Quantizer: per-output-channel symmetric int8, zero-point 0, scale = max|w_row|/127 (the proven frankentorch scheme); deterministic (pure function of input bytes; same source -> same .fttsq, content hash asserted; no RNG, no calibration data).

DONE WHEN: converts the pinned checkpoint under a stated memory ceiling; artifact==runtime byte-identity test green; determinism test (convert twice -> identical bytes) green; conversion provenance (source hash) embedded + verified on load.
notes: POLISH R7: explicit CONVERT E2E SCRIPT required: pinned safetensors -> ftts convert (memory ceiling asserted via RSS sampling, logged) -> census-on-load green -> .fttspack generation -> ONE REAL SYNTHESIS byte-compared to the runtime-quant path (the by-construction parity claim exercised end-to-end); every stage logs wall-clock + content hashes; this script IS the distribution-proof precursor the release bead reuses (convert byte-parity vs published hash).

title: [P2] .fttspack execution cache + KernelPlan persistence
description:
[P2] .fttspack local execution cache + KernelPlan persistence.

WHAT: the regenerable per-machine cache: keyed by {model_content_hash, kernel_abi_version, cpu vendor/model, ISA feature set, op-shape plan, packing version, quant execution mode, autotune-result hash}; contains arch-specific packed layouts (SDOT/i8mm/AVX-VNNI/AVX-512/AMX tile interleavings), the MICRODECODER HOT PACK (physically separated, layout tuned for residency across the 15 steps), and the persisted KernelPlan (which implementation wins per op x shape x regime — seeded by the -1B W8A8 bench, refined by install-time autotune). Safe to DELETE AND REBUILD at any time (regeneration deterministic given the key tuple); robot backends reports the active plan.

WHY THE SPLIT: one canonical download serves every machine; layouts evolve freely; rollback is clean; autotuning becomes an install-time freedom instead of a publishing constraint.

DONE WHEN: pack generation from .fttsq works; key-tuple invalidation tested (changing any component regenerates); delete-and-rebuild determinism test green; CI verifies every packing dequantizes to identical logical weights.

title: [P2] int8 talker GEMMs (staged lever 2a)
description:
[P2] Staged quant lever 2a: int8 talker GEMMs.

WHAT (ONE LEVER AT A TIME, per-stage revert granularity — lever 2b, the microdecoder, is its own bead p2-int8-microdecoder and follows this one): int8 per-output-channel weights on the talker's q/k/v/o + gate/up/down across all 28 layers (shapes 1024->2048, 1024->1024, 2048->1024, 1024->3072, 3072->1024). Re-prove Contract A (teacher-forced ladders; greedy token stream vs the f32 baseline) + Contract B (distributional metrics within floor-derived budget). Activation mode (W8A8 dynamic vs W8A16 weight-only) per the -1B bench winners, wired per op class via KernelPlan.

KEPT HIGH PRECISION (the recipe's protected set — validated against OQ-13's GGML enumeration; any tensor THEY keep high that WE quantize is OUR risk behind a kill-switch): ALL norms (incl. QK-Norm weights), sampling-logits boundaries, RVQ codec codebooks, speaker-conditioning path, speaker-encoder output layers.

STAGING ORDER + WHY: talker (2a, this bead) -> microdecoder (2b) -> heads (3, gated) -> codec Q8 (4, listening-gated). The talker goes first because it is the LOWER quality risk (its output is one semantic-rich code the ladder verifies argmax-exactly) and it unblocks kernel work (the int8 kernel bead needs real int8 artifacts to bench against).

GATES: ConformanceExact re-proof + ProductionQuality budgets + the AF-2 tail gate; a regression reverts JUST this stage (ledgered).

DONE WHEN: lever landed with parity receipts (equivalence class stated in the commit subject); FTTS_* kill-switch wired with a structurally unchanged unarmed path; ledger row filed; unit tests per the test-observability convention.

title: [P2] int8 heads (gated, beyond validated set)
description:
[P2] Staged quant lever 3: int8 code/lm heads (GATED — beyond the validated set).

WHAT: int8 on the talker primary head + the 15 per-depth 2048-way microdecoder heads (~31.5 MB combined). EXPLICITLY BEYOND the community-validated recipe -> ships behind FTTS_INT8_HEADS (default per measurement), each direction of the flag leaving the unarmed path structurally unchanged.

WHY GATED: heads feed sampling logits directly — the error-amplifying boundary; the protected-set doctrine keeps logits boundaries high-precision by default, so this lever must EARN its default with Contract-B budgets + listening evidence, not inherit it.

DONE WHEN: measured verdict (keep default-on / keep opt-in / revert) with Contract A+B receipts and the AF-2 tail check; ledger row with the do-not-retry predicate if reverted.
notes: POLISH R8 correction: the combined figure is ~34.5 MB (15 per-depth microdecoder heads ~31.5 MB + the talker primary head ~3 MB) — the description's '~31.5 MB combined' counts the depth heads only. Traffic-model rows elsewhere are correct (they list the two separately).

title: [P2] Codec Q8 (listening-gated)
description:
[P2] Staged quant lever 4: codec Q8 (listening-gated).

WHAT: quantize the codec decoder per the GGML-validated shape (Q8 convs/attention weights; RVQ CODEBOOKS + sensitive boundary layers stay high-precision per OQ-13's enumerated set).

THE GATE IS EARS, NOT JUST METRICS: codec quantization is where sibilance/breath/pitch-stability damage hides; this lever passes only through the operationalized listening protocol (ABX/TOST equivalence on the canary axes) IN ADDITION to Contract-B numbers. The waveform is the continuous artifact — spectral distances + listening, never byte comparisons.

DONE WHEN: Q8 codec within equivalence bounds on all canary axes; artifact sections wired (HOT_CODEC_DECODER); receipts + ledger row; f32 codec remains available as the escape hatch (FTTS_QUANT selection).

title: [P2] Text-embedding Q8 experiment (622->311 MB)
description:
[P2] Text-embedding Q8 experiment (footprint lever, separately gated).

WHAT: quantize the ~622 MB BF16 text embedding (151,936 x 2048) to Q8 (~311 MB saved; artifact drops from ~1.6 GB-class toward ~1.3 GB-class — NOTE the community Q8 conversion already quantizes it, which is exactly why their 993 MB talker figure looks small).

WHY SEPARATE: v1's "keep all embeddings high-precision" was too coarse — the text embedding is COLD (row-wise prefill access) with a completely different risk profile than acoustic RVQ codebooks (which stay protected). Risk surface: token-embedding perturbations propagate through the whole talker — gate on Contract-B distributional metrics + WER band + a listening spot-check, not assumption.

DONE WHEN: measured verdict with receipts; if kept, the artifact-size table updates everywhere it is quoted; ledger row either way.

title: [P2] robot selftest + i32-overflow proofs (permanent law)
description:
[P2] robot selftest + i32-overflow proof suite (permanent law, shipped).

WHAT — TWO INSEPARABLE DELIVERABLES: (1) THE OVERFLOW PROOF SUITE: for EVERY int8 kernel class, proof that the i32 accumulator cannot overflow at THIS model's real worst-case K — unit tests multiplying worst-case saturated operands asserting i32 == i64 reference, on every kernel tier. THE K TABLE (from census; recompute if OQ-2/OQ-7 shift it): talker/microdecoder down_proj K=3072 -> U8S8 <= 3072*255*127 ~= 99.5M (>=21x i32 headroom); o_proj K=2048 -> ~66.3M; other GEMMs K<=1024; codec conv reduction lengths C_in*kernel_width from OQ-7 (whether or not im2col is ever materialized); the seq-16 verification pass shares per-element K bounds (larger m does not change per-output accumulation). (2) THE `ftts robot selftest` SUBCOMMAND: re-proves ON THE END USER'S SILICON: dispatched-kernel == scalar-oracle exact i32 equality at real model shapes for every tier the machine exposes; all overflow rows; capability-vs-actually-executed route reporting; NDJSON verdict rows. This is what the release's distribution proofs and the runtime-health scalar-fallback trigger consume.

PERMANENT LAW: every FUTURE kernel class (Q4 unpack path, codec convs, verification pass, batched variants, any Metal path) ships its own worst-case-K selftest row BEFORE it can become a default. AVX2 vpmaddubsw saturates at i16 before widening — it carries its own split-accumulate proof or a ledgered DISC.

DONE WHEN: suite covers every existing tier + the census K table; `robot selftest` emits per-row verdicts and integrates with the ISA-fallback health gate; the permanent-law rule documented where kernel authors will see it (ftts-kernels crate docs); fault-injection (a deliberately broken kernel) trips both selftest and fallback.

title: [3A] KernelTeam (persistent workers, N-bucket rebind)
description:
[3A] KernelTeam: the fixed hot-loop execution architecture.

WHAT: fixed, long-lived workers executing the hot math (replacing rayon on the decode path — v1 had three scheduling systems, one too many): static output-channel partitions per op; sense-reversing barrier / generation counter; per-op ACTIVE worker counts (a 1024-row GEMV may want 4 workers while a seq-16 block pass wants 12 — counts from the AF-5 USL sweep, 3D bead); no closures, no work-stealing, no per-layer task submission in steady state; affinity from the hardware plan (P-cores on Apple; CCD-aware on AMD); the ONE-PARALLEL-OWNER-AT-A-TIME invariant enforced by construction. VARIABLE BATCH SIZE IS A DESIGNED CASE: precomputed partition tables per N-bucket; rebind only at scheduling-quantum boundaries; hysteresis so churn cannot thrash the plan (continuous batching changes N every quantum).

DIVISION OF LABOR: asupersync = orchestration/cancellation/IO only; KernelTeam = hot math; rayon remains for the f32 port, converters, enrollment — and as the CORRECTNESS/PERF INCUMBENT the team must measurably beat to land (keep-gate; else revert + ledger).

WHY: at 12.5 frames/s x (28 + 15x5) layer evaluations, per-step overhead (pool wakeups, task objects, allocator) is a visible fraction of each 80 ms budget; a persistent dispatch-free team converts directly into TTFA and RTF.

DONE WHEN: team runs the talker+microdecoder loops bit-identically to the rayon baseline; A/B shows the win (thermal-paired, cv<=5); no allocation/dispatch in steady state (verified by instrumentation); watchdog + loom-style/stress tests for the barrier protocol.

title: [3A] Exact-shape int8 kernels + KernelPlan autotuner
description:
[3A] Exact-shape int8 GEMV/GEMM kernels + KernelPlan autotuner v1.

WHAT (in ftts-kernels, the only unsafe-permitted crate; every intrinsic island named, SAFETY-commented, feature-gated, with a bit-identical scalar fallback that cross-compiles everywhere): the model's exact shapes hardcoded (1024->2048, 1024->1024, 2048->1024, 1024->3072, 3072->1024, the 2048-way heads, codec 512-family): aarch64 SDOT (+SMMLA where measured to win — inherited prior: M4 SMMLA issues at half rate, prefer SDOT on macOS; REVERIFY per toolchain), x86 AVX-512-VNNI / AVX-VNNI (U8S8 with the +128 fold) / AVX2 (vpmaddubsw with its own saturation proof), scalar floor. i32 accumulation, scales post-accumulation, fused bias/activation + requant. The KernelPlan autotuner v1: seeded from -1B W8A8/W8A16 winners, measures per (op x shape x m-regime x ISA) on install, persists to .fttspack; NO fixed ISA hierarchy.

BINDING CONSTRAINTS (inherited, re-confirm locally): never hand-SIMD the glue (norms/softmax/dequant — LLVM autovec won; ~5x lesson); register/cache blocking mandatory for any SMMLA/tile path (unblocked SMMLA lost to SDOT); autovec BEAT hand-SDOT at m=1 on M4 — the scalar-autovec variant is a live KernelPlan candidate, not just a fallback.

DONE WHEN: every kernel bit-identical to scalar on every tier (integer exactness — SIMD==scalar i32 equality, no tolerance); overflow selftest rows pass; autotuned plan beats any fixed assignment on at least one SKU (else ledger why); benches per shape wired.
notes: POLISH R9 SPLIT: the KernelPlan AUTOTUNER is now its own bead (k-kernelplan-autotuner) — this bead owns the KERNEL IMPLEMENTATIONS ONLY (per-ISA int8 GEMV/GEMM at the exact model shapes, bit-identical to scalar on every tier, overflow selftest rows). The autotuner bead owns the winner-search engine, plan persistence, and doctor re-tune integration. Rationale: a search/measurement engine bundled inside a kernel bead hid its distinct correctness surface (timing hygiene, plan stability, invalidation).

title: [3A] ResidualCodeDecoder engine + MTP hot pack
description:
[3A] ResidualCodeDecoder: the dedicated microdecoder engine + MTP hot pack.

WHAT: a dedicated engine, NOT a generic mini-transformer: fixed 15-step loop, fixed 5-layer topology, compile-time shapes; tiny fixed-size KV arrays RESET once per frame (<=16 positions — lives in private cache; its weights, not its attention history, are the problem); precomputed plain-RoPE table for positions 0-15 (16 rows — no trig in the loop); direct per-depth embedding + head selection (indexed arrays, no dispatch); NO dynamic cache objects, NO generation machinery, NO allocation, NO full probability vectors outside the top-k/sampler path. THE MTP HOT PACK in .fttspack: the FULL ~110 MB-class hot working set (body ~79 MB + 15 heads ~31.5 MB + depth embeds + scales + RoPE table + scratch; exact bytes from OQ-2) physically separated, layout tuned for residency across the 15 steps, benchmarked against the talker's generic layout.

PHYSICS HONESTY (v2.1): in exact sequential mode there is NO cross-step scheduling freedom (step t+1 depends on step t's sampled token) — the win here is pure cache residency + layout; true weight-stationary execution exists ONLY in the FrankenMTP verification pass and cross-stream batching. If residency fails on a SKU (per the -1B/OQ-18 verdict), the engineered failure playbook applies: Q4 depth waterfall, head/embedding packing, software prefetch at layer boundaries, huge pages, CCD/SLC pinning — best measured combination ships per SKU via .fttspack.

DONE WHEN: bit-identical to the Phase-1 sequential baseline (greedy ids exact; sampled distribution-equal at matched seeds); measured DRAM bytes/frame vs the one-read floor published per SKU; steady-state zero-allocation verified; per-depth benches (microdecoder_step, microdecoder_frame15) wired.
