Indexing depth_emb[i] with code i produces plausible-but-wrong audio and never crashes.

C-3 — the microdecoder's RoPE theta is 1e6, the SAME as the talker's, not 1e4.
'Plain RoPE' means no mRoPE sectioning (rope_scaling: null), NOT a different theta.
code_predictor_config.rope_theta = 1000000. A port defaulting to 1e4 is silently wrong.
(The codec decoder is the one using theta 1e4, with sliding_window 72 — three rotary configs total,
not the two the plan's §2.10 states.)

Also relevant here — E-1: QK-Norm IS present on the microdecoder (modeling_qwen3_tts.py:910-929),
RMSNorm over head_dim only, applied BEFORE RoPE, eps=1e-06. attention_bias: false (no QKV/O biases).

Full detail + citations: docs/truth-pack/FACT_DISPOSITIONS.md (C-2, C-3, E-1).

title: [3A] Seq-16 verification kernel (multi-head-per-position)
description:
[3A] The seq-16 verification kernel (multi-head-per-position block pass).

WHAT: the FrankenMTP verifier: run the 5-layer microdecoder body over the 1+15=16-position frame sequence in ONE causal pass (one body read instead of 15; healthier matrix utilization + output-channel parallelism) — but NOT a stock LM pass: each residual position applies its OWN depth-specific embedding to the drafted id and its OWN 2048-way head; the kernel is a custom MULTI-HEAD-PER-POSITION engine (shared body over the sequence + per-position embed/head application), and the per-depth head+embed traffic (~31.5 MB + embeds) is part of its cost model.

CORRECTNESS CONTRACT (OQ-5 decides the claim tier): masking, position ids, and the depth-index -> sequence-index -> head-index mapping must be BIT-EQUIVALENT to the training-mode forward; the primary/conditioning position is FROZEN during verification; the verifier scores exactly the 15 residual positions. An off-by-one here invalidates the flagship — the metamorphic invariant (verify-then-repair can never emit a mask-impossible depth sequence) guards it.

DONE WHEN: teacher-forced: verifier logits at every depth EQUAL the sequential engine's logits for the same prefix (the definitional test of Tier-1 equivalence); its own overflow selftest row; bench (seq-16 pass vs 15 sequential steps) recorded per SKU.

title: [3A] FrankenMTP v1 (drafter 1 + greedy speculation)
description:
[3A] FrankenMTP v1: drafter #1 + greedy-mode speculative decode.

WHAT: the first end-to-end speculative loop: drafter #1 = previous-frame residuals + a small transition model (counting statistics from generated audio — NO gradient training, NO lab dependency); verify the drafted block via the seq-16 kernel; STRICT/GREEDY MODE acceptance = "draft id equals verifier argmax at that position" — token-identical to sequential greedy BY CONSTRUCTION; at first rejection, take the verifier's argmax at that position, then REGENERATE the remaining depths (sequential-suffix vs re-draft+re-verify — a measured policy choice; NEVER verify the stale suffix, its context changed); fall back to pure sequential when acceptance is poor.

THE RANKING GATE: keep/revert judged against the -1B break-even curve alpha*(SKU) using the expected-case cost T(alpha) = T_draft + T_verify + (1-alpha_full)*T_repair — partial accepts at depth k can be WORSE than pure sequential; the high-acceptance asymptote (~0.55 GB/frame; 5x-RT demand dropping from ~103 GB/s sequential-baseline toward mid-30s) is the ceiling, not the plan. NOTE the per-SKU composition with the hot pack: where residency holds, the win is serial latency/compute shape; where it fails, this is the traffic lever.

INVARIANTS (already registered in the metamorphic bead, activate here): greedy FrankenMTP ids == greedy sequential ids; speculation-off == sequential byte-for-byte (strict).

DONE WHEN: measured alpha per corpus segment; keep/revert verdict vs alpha*(SKU) with thermal-paired A/B receipts; ledger row either way; kill-switch (FTTS_SPEC_MTP) with structurally unchanged unarmed path.

title: [OQ-19/3A] Sampled-mode speculative rule + proof
description:
[OQ-19 / 3A] Sampled-mode speculative rule: named algorithm + distributional-correctness proof.

WHAT (A RESEARCH DELIVERABLE, not a checklist row): the production sampler runs T=0.9/top_k=50 at BOTH levels + repetition penalty on the talker. Sampled-mode FrankenMTP requires a NAMED speculative-sampling algorithm with a proof that: (a) accepted prefixes are distributed EXACTLY as the sequential sampler's output; (b) rejections resample from the verifier's ADJUSTED conditional (never the draft's); (c) top-k truncation interactions are resolved explicitly (truncated supports break naive speculative-sampling acceptance ratios — the modified residual distribution must renormalize over the top-k support); (d) repetition-penalty state interacts correctly across accepted spans.

CATEGORY SEPARATION (v2.1 doctrine): AF-3's e-value bound is a RELIABILITY MONITOR (how often the path misbehaves) — it is NOT a substitute for distributional exactness; "disagreement is rare" and "samples are legal" are different claims. Without this proof, sampled-mode speculation ships ONLY under Tier-2 claims (approximate assistance, Contract-B gates).

DONE WHEN: algorithm written up with the proof (or a documented counter-verdict adopting Tier 2 for sampled mode); implementation + statistical validation (many-seed distribution comparison vs pure sequential sampling at matched logits); the claim tier recorded in the ledger and release docs.

title: [3A/AF-3] E-value reliability monitor (speculation kill-switch)
description:
[3A/AF-3] The e-value reliability monitor + FrankenMTP kill-switch.

WHAT (alien-artifact family AF-3 — consumer: the FrankenMTP kill-switch; deletion condition: FrankenMTP abandoned): an anytime-valid sequential test (e-process) monitoring the speculative path in production — bounding the rate of draft-path misbehavior (disagreement beyond expectation, repair-loop anomalies, invariant near-misses) at risk level alpha; alarm -> automatic fallback to the exact sequential path + a health event through SynthesisObserver/robot; alpha->0 disables speculation entirely (the deterministic fallback, wired FIRST).

WHY AN E-PROCESS: valid at every stopping time without multiple-testing penalties — the right tool for an always-on production monitor (Ville's inequality), matching the gauntlet's invariant-monitoring machinery.

EXPLICITLY NOT: an exactness proof (that is OQ-19). This is the runtime insurance that makes shipping speculation responsible even at Tier 1.

DONE WHEN: monitor implemented + calibration fixture committed (p0/lambda/alpha choices documented on the transparency card); fault-injection tests (deliberately broken drafter -> alarm + fallback); assumptions ledger + deterministic fallback demonstrated.

title: [3A] MTP-first Q4 depth waterfall (double-gated)
description:
[3A] MTP-first Q4: packed int4 kernel + depth waterfall (double-gated).

WHAT: a genuinely NATIVE packed Q4 kernel (in-register unpack feeding the same int8 MAC units — there is no CPU int4 multiply; the win is bytes streamed, and the inherited prior says unpack cost made int4 5.8x SLOWER in a sibling at different shapes — REPROVE at ours), then the placement waterfall IN THIS ORDER: (1) later microdecoder residual depths only, (2) whole microdecoder body, (3) microdecoder heads, (4) talker MLPs, (5) talker attention projections.

WHY MICRODECODER-FIRST (inverted from the naive talker-first order): the body is reread 15x per frame — Q4 shrinks ~79 MB toward ~40 MB, potentially buying CACHE RESIDENCY on SKUs where Q8 fails (a step-function win, not a linear one); later acoustic codebook depths are plausibly less perceptually sensitive than the first semantic-rich code; an MTP-only rollback is clean. PER-DEPTH PRECISION IS A FIRST-CLASS AXIS (AF-1 formalizes the allocation in Phase 5).

THE DOUBLE GATE (both required): (a) faster END-TO-END on each actual target ISA including unpack cost; (b) blind listeners cannot distinguish it under the equivalence-bound protocol on identity, naturalness, sibilance, breath, pitch stability, long-form prosody. A smaller file that runs slower or subtly damages identity is a FAILED artifact.

DONE WHEN: kernel + overflow row + per-depth waterfall measurements; verdict per placement stage with receipts (keep/revert each independently); ledger rows; .fttsq/.fttspack support for mixed per-depth precision.

title: [3B] Persistent talker loop + two-pass norm-quant fusion
description:
[3B] Persistent talker loop + correct norm->quant fusion.

WHAT: the 28-layer talker on the KernelTeam as a persistent dispatch-free loop. Per-layer fused pass 1: RMSNorm -> QKV -> QK-Norm (if OQ-3 confirmed) -> mRoPE -> GQA attention over the KV cache -> O-proj -> residual. Pass 2: RMSNorm -> gate||up (one input quant shared) -> SiLU-mul -> down -> residual. THE CORRECT TWO-PASS NORM->QUANT FUSION (RMSNorm needs a global reduction before any normalized value exists — one-pass claims are wrong): pass 1 computes sum-of-squares AND max|x_i*gamma_i| in one sweep; derive the RMS factor and the dynamic quant scale (max|normalized| = max|x*gamma|/rms); pass 2 emits QUANTIZED normalized activations directly into aligned scratch — no materialized f32 normalized vector; Q/K/V reuse that one quantized input, gate/up reuse the post-attention norm's. Also fuse residual-add with the NEXT norm's statistics collection where the arithmetic-order contract permits.

STEADY STATE: workers persist across all 28 layers + 15 microdecoder steps + successive frames; zero allocation, zero dispatch; KV preallocated from census.

DONE WHEN: bit-identical to the Phase-1 talker (greedy streams equal; teacher-forced parity re-proven); fusion proven byte-identity-preserving per the equivalence rules; A/B vs unfused with thermal pairing; roofline distance published per SKU.

title: [3B] Tiled register-blocked prefill GEMM (the wedge)
description:
[3B] Register-blocked tiled prefill GEMM (the wedge kernel).

WHAT: the tiled, register-blocked SMMLA/VNNI int8 GEMM for prefill-class shapes (long-m text/ICL prompt processing + the text projection MLP 2048->2048->1024) — the kernel frankentorch NAMES but does not ship; building it is our wedge. Requirements from the inherited graveyard: register/cache blocking with compute:load >= 2:1 (an unblocked SMMLA with 2x MAC density LOST to SDOT — load-bound); offline weight pre-packing into the tile layout (.fttspack; zero runtime shuffle); B stays in native [out,in] checkpoint layout (no transpose ever); L2-blocked B-panels.

WHY PREFILL MATTERS: TTFA (the interactive profile's headline) = prefill + first frame + first codec packet; ICL prompts (reference text + codec tokens + target text) can be hundreds of positions; this GEMM is that path's floor. Also serves the seq-16 verification pass and 3D batched execution (m = stream count).

DONE WHEN: bit-identical (i32-exact) to scalar; beats the GEMV-loop alternative at prefill shapes on every target ISA (else ledgered); prefill-stage bench + roofline distance recorded; TTFA delta measured end-to-end.

title: [3B] Prompt partial evaluation + voice-cache prefix KV
description:
[3B] Prompt partial evaluation + .ftvoice-cache prefix KV reuse.

WHAT: skip recomputing the voice-dependent, target-text-INDEPENDENT prompt prefix on every utterance: precompute static prompt embeddings + verified static-prefix KV at enrollment (or first use), store in .ftvoice-cache keyed by {voice_recipe_hash, model_hash, prompt_builder_version, streaming_mode, quant_recipe, math_mode, engine_abi}; at synthesis, load + validate the key tuple, then prefill only the target-dependent suffix.

THE SAFETY RULE (OQ-10 is the authority): cache ONLY the maximal prefix PROVEN independent of target text — the official ICL prompt interleaves reference text, target text, reference codec tokens, and mode-dependent alignment, and streaming/non-streaming prompts differ structurally; caching one target-dependent position silently corrupts synthesis. All source primitives stay in the portable .ftvoice so caches regenerate after ANY bump (a cache is an optimization, never the only copy).

DONE WHEN: prompt-cache == full-prefill metamorphic gate green (bit-identical KV + identical downstream tokens in strict mode); TTFA improvement measured per voice; key-tuple invalidation tests; cold-vs-warm TTFA both reported honestly.

title: [3B] Long-context KV layout + admission integration
description:
[3B] Long-context KV layout + admission integration.

WHAT: the talker KV cache engineered for the full duration range: contiguous per-head layout streamed once per step (layout is the win at these lengths — 12.5 frames/s means even 10 minutes is only ~7500 frames + prompt; attention compute is minor next to the GEMVs, so no exotic algorithms assumed necessary — online-softmax tiling only if profiles ever show cache hostility); preallocation from the census per admitted request; growth beyond the context limit follows the OFFICIAL long-form chunking policy (OQ-6) — never an invented rolling-window scheme; integration with resource admission (predicted max frames -> KV bytes -> admit/reject BEFORE allocation).

DONE WHEN: KV layout benchmarked vs alternatives at short/medium/long-form durations; admission formulas tested at the boundaries (max duration, context limit); long-form runs exercise the official chunking path with parity spot-checks vs the oracle's long-form output.

title: [3C] Optimized stateful codec kernels (fused, ring-buffer)
description:
[3C] Optimized stateful codec kernels.

WHAT: the codec decoder at kernel quality co-equal with the talker work (the classic TTS-port blind spot is optimizing the LM and discovering the codec dominates): stateful causal Conv1d with persistent ring buffers (receptive-field-sized from OQ-7, preallocated, state across packets); FUSED conv+bias+norm+activation (one pass per conv, ring-buffer-aware); specialized small attention at the exact codec shape (hidden 512, 16 heads x head_dim 64 — attention width 1024 = 2x hidden — sliding window 72; a dedicated fixed-shape variant, not the talker kernel); NO im2col materialization (direct conv loops at these small fixed shapes; LLVM autovec where int8 does not apply); upsample [8,5,4,3] streaming DIRECTLY into the output PCM buffer; distinct encode/decode builds preserved.

QUANT MODE: per KernelPlan (the codec conv may be a W8A16 or BF16 winner — the -1B bench decides, not assumption); RVQ codebooks stay high-precision.

DONE WHEN: bit-identical to the Phase-1 codec in strict mode; codec-stage roofline distance published; codec_packet_1/2/4 benches wired; overflow rows for conv reduction lengths in the selftest.

title: [3C] Packet autotuning + profile wiring
description:
[3C] Packet autotuning + profile wiring.

WHAT: packet size (1/2/4/auto frames) as a true execution-policy parameter: the auto policy selects per (SKU, profile) from the -1B packet experiments + local autotune; profiles map interactive->1-2 frames (first audible sample sooner: 80-160 ms of audio per packet), balanced->4 (the official 320 ms packetization), throughput->larger codec batches where measured to help, strict->conformance packetization exactly matching the official streaming semantics (OQ-14). Cancellation checks EVERY 80 ms talker frame regardless of packet size (G8); packet metadata flows through audio_chunk robot events.

DONE WHEN: profile->packet defaults justified from data (committed table); packet-equality metamorphic gate green across all sizes; TTFA per profile measured + reported per SKU; auto policy beats any fixed choice on at least one SKU or is simplified away (ledgered).

title: [3C] Streaming certification (backpressure, cancel, sustained)
description:
[3C] Streaming certification: backpressure, cancellation, sustained runs.

WHAT: certify the streaming path end-to-end against the reliability contract: streaming==offline BIT-IDENTITY under chunk-boundary fuzz schedules (randomized packet/chunk splits never change output); backpressure (consumer stall parks the producer at the bounded queue; budget then cancels; memory bounded throughout — verified under a deliberately slow consumer); cancellation during codec emission finalizes at the frame boundary with a valid partial WAV; audio/event channel independence (cannot deadlock each other — fault-injection tested); SUSTAINED STREAMING: long-form multi-minute runs at each profile with thermal reporting (the 30-minute sustained gate's streaming half), memory flat (zero steady-state allocation confirmed over time), the many_utterances watchdog extended to streaming mode.

WHY ITS OWN BEAD: streaming failure semantics are where real products die quietly; every failure mode gets a named test with detailed logging, not a hope.

DONE WHEN: all failure-injection scenarios pass with structured errors; sustained runs green with flat memory + thermal logs; streaming rows land in the release scorecard.

title: [3D] Continuous frame/depth batching scheduler
description:
[3D] Continuous frame/depth batching scheduler.

WHAT: the AMD-throughput architecture: a central frame scheduler that (per scheduling quantum) collects all streams ready for their next frame, batches the TALKER step across them (GEMV -> GEMM; weights read once per step, not once per stream), then for residual_depth 0..14 batches THAT DEPTH across all active streams (valid because streams are independent — each stream's depth-d token depends only on its OWN depth-(d-1); batching per depth respects every stream's autoregressive chain), then batches/pipelines codec packets, then returns each stream to its own sequential state.

OWNERSHIP INVARIANT (doctrine 5): this scheduler IS the engine's single parallel owner — multi-stream inside ONE fan-out, never N concurrent fan-outs; fttsd admission later rides the same capacity model. Two policies: Latency (one stream, small static team, minimal queueing) and Throughput (continuous batching, configurable queue delay, weight-stationary scheduling, NUMA-local packs).

CORRECTNESS: batch==singleton per stream (strict mode) — every stream's output identical to solo execution; the -1B answer to "at what stream count does batched GEMM overtake per-stream GEMV" sets the batching threshold.

DONE WHEN: batch==singleton green; aggregate-RTF/socket + streams/socket measured vs the isolated-engines alternative (the win must be demonstrated, not assumed); queue-delay policy tunable + documented.

title: [3D] Ragged FrankenMTP x batching joint scheduler
description:
[3D] Ragged FrankenMTP x batching: the joint scheduler design.

WHAT (v2.1 hardness item — two flagship systems must share ONE scheduler design, not meet by accident in production): under speculation, streams reject at different depths, so depth-synchronized batching goes RAGGED. Design + measure the joint policy; candidates: pad-and-mask cohorts (verify all streams to depth 15, mask rejected tails); cohort splitting by accept depth; a DUAL-LANE scheduler (block-verify lane + sequential-repair lane, streams migrating between lanes per frame); per-cohort re-drafting. Jointly owned by 3A (speculation semantics) + 3D (batching mechanics); the KernelTeam's N-bucket rebind rules (hysteresis, quantum-boundary rebinding) absorb the resulting batch-size churn.

DECISION CRITERIA: aggregate RTF under mixed acceptance distributions (from 3A's measured alpha), tail latency of repair-lane streams, scheduler complexity. Pure-sequential-lane fallback is always available (speculation off per stream).

DONE WHEN: chosen policy implemented + A/B-ed against speculation-off batching under realistic acceptance mixes; per-stream strict-mode identity still green (batching + speculation composed); design doc committed as the shared 3A/3D artifact.

title: [3D] NUMA-local packs + CCD affinity
description:
[3D] NUMA-local packs + CCD affinity.

WHAT: on multi-die AMD (Threadripper/EPYC): replicate or partition the .fttspack weight sections NUMA-node-locally (cross-node weight fetches are the silent killer; the read-only hot sections replicate cheaply when concurrency warrants); pin stream cohorts + their KernelTeam workers CCD-aware; first-touch or explicit replication policy via FTTS_NUMA={replicate|interleave|local} (default local + first-touch); per-node activation buffers.

WHY: continuous batching multiplies bandwidth demand; a 64-core EPYC serving cross-CCD weight reads throttles on infinity-fabric, not DRAM. The -1B per-CCD residency data feeds placement.

DONE WHEN: NUMA policies implemented behind the env switch; measured streams/socket + aggregate RTF with/without locality on a multi-CCD box; policy defaults set from measurement; capacity certificate records the topology assumptions.

title: [3D] Admission control + capacity certificate
description:
[3D] Admission control + queueing policy + the capacity certificate.

WHAT: server-mode admission: each incoming request is admitted only if the capacity model says the socket can hold it (streams x per-stream budgets <= physical-core + bandwidth budget; per-request resource admission from the reliability gates composes in); configurable queue delay (batching efficiency vs p95 admission-to-first-packet latency); overload behavior = fast structured rejection, never silent degradation of admitted streams. THE CAPACITY CERTIFICATE (a gauntlet artifact): p95/p99 queueing evidence under load, proof of no nested-runtime/no oversubscription (one fan-out), the topology + policy assumptions — published per SKU class.

METRICS OWNED HERE (the throughput-profile headline set): aggregate RTF (generated-audio-seconds per wall-clock second per socket), streams/socket, p95 admission-to-first-packet queueing latency, joules per generated minute (OQ-17 method).

DONE WHEN: admission + queueing implemented + load-tested (including overload + burst patterns with detailed logs); certificate generated per test SKU; metrics wired into the bench harness + scorecard.

title: [3D/AF-5] USL pool/team sizing sweeps
description:
[3D/AF-5] USL pool/team sizing sweeps.

WHAT (alien-artifact family AF-5 — consumer: .fttspack pool_sizing + robot backends + the admission policy; deletion condition: fixed counts measure equal): fit the Universal Scalability Law C(N) = N / (1 + a(N-1) + bN(N-1)) to thread sweeps per (arch, op-class): talker GEMV, microdecoder step, seq-16 verify pass, prefill GEMM, codec conv, batched GEMM at several m. CAP each op's active-worker count at its USL peak, never at num_cpus (over-threading a bandwidth-bound GEMV is a measured anti-win — the fitted b term quantifies coherency cost); the results feed the KernelTeam per-op active-worker counts, the N-bucket partition tables, and the continuous-batching admission policy.

DONE WHEN: sweeps run per SKU with cv% gates; fitted curves + chosen caps committed (transparency card: equation, fitted values, plain-English intuition, validity assumptions, flip conditions); measured throughput at chosen N >= throughput at num_cpus on every op class (the proof obligation); fallback (physical-core count) wired first.

title: [P4] .ftvoice + .ftvoice-cache formats (consent, profiles)
description:
[P4] .ftvoice portable format + .ftvoice-cache (the two-layer voice artifact) + VOICE_COMPILER_DESIGN.md.

WHAT: PORTABLE .ftvoice (stable identity data): reference hashes + provenance + CONSENT ATTESTATION (doctrine 10: recorded at enrollment; --consent-attest for non-interactive); transcript + alignment; selected speech regions; speaker embedding; reference codec tokens; diagnostics + enrollment-quality scores; language metadata; the REPRODUCIBLE PREPROCESSING RECIPE (so re-enrollment is deterministic); optionally embedded lossless normalized reference audio. PROFILES: --voice-pack portable (embeds reference) / private (derived features only) / minimal (embedding only) — privacy is a deliberate, documented product choice. DERIVED .ftvoice-cache (recomputable ONLY): static prompt embeddings, verified static-prefix KV, backend layouts, quantized cached states, packet-mode codec context; keyed by {voice_recipe_hash, model_hash, prompt_builder_version, streaming_mode, quant_recipe, math_mode, engine_abi}. A .ftvoice must survive a model-revision bump by re-deriving from stored primitives — caches are optimizations, never the only copy.

ALSO OWNS: docs/VOICE_COMPILER_DESIGN.md — skeleton committed with this bead (formats, profiles, privacy rationale, cache-key semantics); finalized as the Phase-4 beads land (segment discovery, transcript verification, multi-ref policies fold their design records in).

HARDENING: same acceptance criteria as .fttsq (checked arithmetic, digests, truncation/bit-flip tests, fuzz targets).

DONE WHEN: read/write + all three profiles; idempotence (identical input -> identical portable artifact, hash-stable — a metamorphic gate); cache invalidation on every key-tuple component tested; ftts voice inspect renders everything human- and JSON-readably; the design doc skeleton exists and is linked from the README docs map.

title: [P4] Enrollment pipeline (diagnostics, quality/quick/auto)
description:
[P4] Enrollment pipeline: diagnostics + three modes (quality/quick/auto).

WHAT: ftts enroll end-to-end: decode/resample reference -> VAD + diagnostics (clipping, SNR, reverberation, background music, multi-speaker/overlap detection, stationarity) -> mode selection: QUALITY (transcript-backed ICL: verified transcript + codec-encoder tokens + cached prompt state — the quality path), QUICK (x-vector only: ECAPA embedding, no transcript — upstream documents possible quality reduction and the CLI says so), AUTO (ICL when the transcript verifies, else x-vector WITH A WARNING) — never presented as interchangeable equals. Warnings are LOUD (continuation-style cloners reproduce prompt-recording defects — tell the user BEFORE they hear it); refusal (exit 8) reserved for unusable input with --force for consenting adults. Consent attestation recorded; NO acquisition features (no URL fetchers) — doctrine 10.

DONE WHEN: all three modes produce working .ftvoice packs whose synthesis matches oracle-enrolled baselines; every diagnostic has a unit test with a synthetic defect fixture (clipped/reverberant/music-bed/two-speaker samples); warning + refusal paths tested; enrollment time measured.
notes: POLISH R7: explicit ENROLLMENT E2E SCRIPT required (the voice compiler's version of the CLI e2e): spawn real binaries — ftts enroll ref.wav (each of the three modes) -> ftts voice inspect --json (validate every field incl. consent + diagnostics + quality scores) -> ftts say --voice pack.ftvoice -> validate output WAV; structured logs at every stage (mode chosen + why, diagnostics values, embedding hash, token counts, synthesis timing) so a failed enrollment localizes instantly; runs model-gated in CI; reused by the release smoke suite.

title: [P4/AF-4] Segment discovery + audition ranking + loss model
description:
[P4/AF-4] Reference-segment discovery + audition ranking (the voice compiler's core).

WHAT (alien-artifact family AF-4 — the kernel AFs' peer; consumer: ftts enroll ranking; gate: the audition benchmark; deletion condition: selection never beats whole-file): given a longer recording: detect speech regions -> reject overlapping/multiple speakers -> score clipping/SNR/reverb/music/stationarity -> score phonetic coverage from the transcript when available -> penalize extreme emotion/whisper/atypical register unless requested -> select several candidate 3-12 s segments (submodular selection under a quality-coverage objective) -> SYNTHESIZE A FIXED AUDITION SET from each candidate -> rank by objective metrics + optional listener preference -> preserve the chosen segment AND all alternatives in the enrollment report. Plus the ATTRIBUTE->QUALITY LOSS MODEL: reference attributes (SNR, reverb, clipping, coverage) -> predicted identity/naturalness, CALIBRATED on the audition benchmark (transparency card + assumptions ledger).

WHY: this often buys more user-perceived cloning quality than another kernel lever — the reference IS the voice. Deterministic fallback (wired first): whole-file enrollment.

DONE WHEN: discovery + ranking beat whole-file enrollment on the audition benchmark (listening-protocol instance for enrollment preprocessing); loss-model calibration report committed; enrollment report format (chosen + alternatives + scores) stable.

title: [P4] Transcript verification + ASR plugin contract
description:
[P4] Transcript verification + external ASR plugin contract.

WHAT: a bad reference transcript poisons ICL enrollment silently — verify before trusting: transcript/audio duration consistency; alignment confidence scoring; obvious omission/repetition detection; an OPTIONAL external ASR verifier hook — a clean plugin/companion-tool contract (subprocess with a versioned JSON interface) because the SHIPPING BINARY CONTAINS NO ASR (G3: no foreign ML runtime; WER scorers stay eval-side); on poor confidence, a forced explicit choice: corrected-ICL or x-vector fallback (with the quality warning).

DONE WHEN: verification catches seeded transcript defects (wrong text, missing sentences, duplicated lines) in tests; plugin contract documented + demonstrated with a reference implementation script; the auto-mode decision path (verify -> ICL, else warn + x-vector) integration-tested.

title: [P4] Multi-reference enrollment (selection before averaging)
description:
[P4] Multi-reference enrollment: selection before averaging.

WHAT (experimental, evidence-gated — not an upstream feature with a guaranteed recipe): for users with several short recordings: rank + select high-quality homogeneous references (the AF-4 machinery per reference); evaluate individual references on the audition benchmark FIRST; only then test embedding-level aggregation; PRESERVE per-reference embeddings + provenance always; NEVER irreversibly average away voice/style variation (averaging is not inherently superior to selecting the cleanest representative — the A/B decides).

DONE WHEN: selection-vs-aggregation A/B run through the enrollment listening protocol; the winning policy becomes the multi-ref default with the loser documented; .ftvoice stores the consensus data + all per-reference primitives; ships behind its own flag until the evidence lands.

title: [P5] .fttsdraft lab-to-runtime ABI
description:
[P5] The .fttsdraft lab->runtime ABI.

WHAT: the versioned artifact that lets lab wins land as product instead of staying notebooks: draft/surgery models (distilled drafters, parallel-head predictors, adaptive-depth variants) ship as .fttsdraft beside .fttsq — format-versioned; compatibility-keyed to {base model hash, engine ABI version, drafter type}; kill-switched (a bad draft artifact can be disabled without touching the engine); parsed by the same hardened ftts-artifacts machinery (checked arithmetic, digests, fuzz targets) with its own overflow selftest rows for any new kernel shapes.

WHY: Phase 5's entire value depends on a clean landing path; without an ABI, distillation results rot in experiment dirs. The runtime treats a .fttsdraft as an untrusted plugin: validated, gated, monitored by AF-3.

DONE WHEN: format + reader/writer + validation; a dummy drafter round-trips through it into the FrankenMTP loop; kill-switch + compatibility-refusal tested; fuzz target registered.

title: [P5] Drafter ladder 2-5 (distill, parallel heads, tree verify)
description:
[P5] Drafter ladder #2-#5: distillation, parallel heads, tree verify, cross-frame dynamics.

WHAT (franken_tts_lab; every output re-enters ONLY through the full verification gates): the escalating drafter program against the 15-step monster: (#2) a 1-2 layer DISTILLED microdecoder — including ORACLE RESIDUAL-TRAJECTORY DISTILLATION (teacher-forced residual trajectories from the pinned oracle are FREE supervision — no data collection needed); (#3) 15 PARALLEL residual heads off the talker hidden state (one-shot block proposal); (#4) a quantized/layer-skipped microdecoder copy as its own draft; (#5) block drafts of size 3/5 with TREE VERIFY (verify partial blocks, extend on success — trades verify passes for higher marginal acceptance); plus CROSS-FRAME RESIDUAL DYNAMICS beyond prev-frame copy (temporal structure in residual codes across frames — measure the mutual information first, build the model only if it exists); and JOINT talker->residual conditioning compression.

DECISION FRAME: each drafter is judged on the T(alpha) expected-case surface against its measured acceptance on the golden corpus vs the -1B break-even alpha*(SKU); keep/revert per drafter with ledger rows; the AF-3 monitor covers whichever ships.

DONE WHEN: at least drafters #2 and #3 built + measured; the winning drafter (if any beats #1) shipped via .fttsdraft with Contract A/B + listening receipts; losers ledgered with do-not-retry predicates.

title: [P5] Talker-level speculation (dual-level stack)
description:
[P5] Talker-level speculation (the sibling epic — dual-level speculation).

WHAT (re-sequenced from the deleted v1 flagship — deliberately AFTER the residual layer is won): once FrankenMTP owns the microdecoder, the talker still streams ~440 MB/frame forever; dual-level speculation attacks it: a cheap talker drafter (smaller/distilled/quantized talker, or semantic-code transition priors) proposes primary codes; the full talker verifies (standard speculative decoding at the talker level — here the shared-head assumption actually holds, unlike the microdecoder); composition with FrankenMTP = speculation over the whole hierarchical AR stack.

GATES: same discipline as FrankenMTP — expected-case cost surface, break-even analysis, exactness rules per mode (greedy trivial; sampled needs the OQ-19-class rule at the talker's T0.9/k50/rep1.05), AF-3-class monitoring, strict-mode identity invariants.

DONE WHEN: go/no-go spike measured against the post-3A profile (if the talker is no longer the bottleneck per the re-ranked table, ledger and close); if go: drafter + verify loop shipped via .fttsdraft with full receipts.

title: [P5] Surgery: adaptive depth, early exit, AF-1 allocation (canary-gated)
description:
[P5] Surgery experiments: adaptive depth, early exit, pruning (canary-gated).

WHAT: structural model surgery on the microdecoder (lab track): DEPTH-CONDITIONAL EARLY EXIT (emit fewer than 15 residual codes on easy frames — the codec must tolerate truncated code groups, verify against OQ-7 semantics first); ADAPTIVE microdecoder depth (a learned/heuristic controller choosing depth per frame); predictor PRUNING/layer-dropping; per-depth precision via AF-1 (the rate-distortion water-filling allocator over the (tensor x residual-depth) axes — residual depth is a semantic axis: later acoustic codebooks are plausibly less sensitive than the first semantic-rich code; artifact: bit_allocation_table in .fttsq; fallback: uniform Q8); talker Q4 only if still worthwhile after the MTP-first results.

THE GATE IS SURGERY-SPECIFIC (G1 over G2 applies doubly to surgery): beyond generic Contract B, dedicated canaries — high-frequency loss, speaker identity, SIBILANCE under shallow/adaptive residual depth (dropping late acoustic codebooks plausibly damages exactly the canary axes) — through the listening protocol with equivalence bounds; AF-2 tail gates on every surgery lever.

DONE WHEN: each experiment has a keep/revert verdict with canary receipts; kept levers ship via .fttsdraft/.fttsq behind kill-switches; AF-1's allocation beats uniform at equal footprint or is ledgered.

title: [P5] Conditional 25Hz document-mode engine (evidence-triggered)
description:
[P5] Conditional: the 25Hz document-mode engine (dual-rate product).

TRIGGER (predefined so the decision is evidence-driven, not re-litigated): activates ONLY IF (a) the 12Hz long-form drift gate FAILS on the long-form corpus AND (b) a cloning-capable 25Hz Base checkpoint exists. Context: the paper reports the 25Hz variant outperformed 12Hz in its long-speech evaluation (attributed partly to semantic-token stability) — long-form is a DISTINCT quality regime; we never claim one checkpoint is uniformly optimal for dialogue and 2000-word narration.

IF TRIGGERED: the 25Hz document-mode engine as its own epic SHARING the artifact/kernel machinery (.fttsq model_family entry, same KernelPlan/hot-pack/conformance apparatus; a dual-rate product: interactive 12Hz + document 25Hz in one CLI). Costs to re-derive: 25Hz doubles sequential frames/s — the traffic model, residency question, and FrankenMTP economics all re-price.

IF NOT TRIGGERED: close with the evidence (drift gate green, or no cloning 25Hz Base exists) — a valid outcome.

DONE WHEN: the trigger evaluated with committed evidence; either the epic spawns (with its own -1A-class truth work for the 25Hz checkpoint) or this closes documented.

title: [P6] Metal productization (full-path contract)
description:
[P6] Metal productization under the pre-stated full-path contract.

ENTRY: only if the -1B Metal microdecoder spike said GO. THE CONTRACT (pre-stated so Metal becomes a second full path, not a residual-only toy): (1) INTEGER CROSS-BACKEND CONTRACT — int8 x int8 -> i32 with post-accumulation scales gives EXACT CPU<->GPU equality regardless of accumulation order (the same trick that makes SIMD==scalar exact); the strict-mode conformance apparatus applies unchanged across backends; (2) the persistent command-graph microdecoder (the spike's design productized: 15 residual steps incl. sampling + KV updates without host round trips) PLUS a talker/codec co-residency plan; (3) CPU-FALLBACK INVARIANTS — CPU stays the default product; every Metal path has a CPU twin; the shipped selftest covers both; three independent guards (feature flag + device check + explicit env) before any GPU dispatch; (4) install-time CPU-vs-Metal benchmark policy per chip/quant/prompt-length/concurrency.

EVIDENCE CONTEXT: M5-class fused INT8 Metal precedent (Draw Things: 1.61-1.87x over FP16 matmul; INT8 attention 1.24-1.41x over Metal FlashAttention) — mechanism proof, not our targets. Sampler stays on CPU. Expect the CPU-optimal weight layout to be WRONG for GPU (per-backend layouts live in .fttspack's key space). A negative verdict at any point validly ends the epic with a ledger entry. CUDA sits behind Metal entirely.

DONE WHEN: Metal path passes the full strict-mode conformance suite with CPU-exact integer equality; the policy picks correctly per device; CPU regression suite untouched (zero-regression gate).

title: [P7] Release gauntlet (three pillars, convergence)
description:
[P7] Release gauntlet: three pillars to convergence.

WHAT: the release-certification campaign per /running-the-gauntlet-on-your-rust-port: THREE PILLARS — (a) performance: honest per-stage/per-profile ratios vs the proven baseline + the ROOFLINE-EFFICIENCY rows (each hot stage within its -1B-stated factor of its floor, per SKU — the structural claim that certifies the thesis beyond incumbent deltas); (b) conformance: Contract A ladder receipts + Contract B budgets + listening equivalence + AF-2 CVaR bit; (c) surface parity: every CLI surface, robot event, and feature accounted present/partial/missing (partial never rounds up). CONVERGENCE: >=10 full find-fix rounds with >=2 consecutive clean rounds; conformal LOWER-bound ratchet (release decisions on the lower bound, never point estimates); E-PROCESSES armed over the standing invariants: streaming==batch, admission-before-allocation, i32-overflow at census K, determinism scope, SIMD==scalar, speculation-off==sequential.

ALSO: the SUSTAINED-THERMAL row (30-minute run per OQ-17's method — a turbo-window number is not an interactive-TTS claim); claims stated at their equivalence tiers throughout; NO ADMISSIBLE RATIO where no legitimate baseline exists.

DONE WHEN: convergence reached; scorecard all-green (skip-honest); evidence bundles hash-anchored under docs/gauntlet/.

title: [P7] Cross-platform release + distribution proofs + selftest
description:
[P7] Cross-platform release: builds, installer, distribution proofs, selftest.

WHAT: the 5-target release matrix (linux x86-64/arm64, darwin x86-64/arm64, windows-msvc x86-64): one SELF-CONTAINED binary per target (no Python, no foreign ML/DSP runtime, no C++ ABI, no non-system shared libraries, no network at inference; tiny audited OS-interface islands fine); runtime ISA dispatch means one binary per OS/arch covers every CPU tier. install.sh + archives + SHA-256 checksums. DISTRIBUTION PROOFS: ftts convert byte-parity vs the published artifact hash (anyone can reproduce our .fttsq from the pinned checkpoint); clean-cache pull + ONE REAL SYNTHESIS smoke test per artifact per platform. THE SHIPPED SELFTEST: robot selftest re-proves dispatched-kernel==scalar-oracle + all overflow rows + real model shapes ON THE END USER'S SILICON (capability vs actually-executed route split reported). License: Apache-2.0 attribution + NOTICE in artifacts, --version, README (per OQ-1's obligations).

ALSO: README + docs finalized (honest per-SKU numbers from the scorecard — no blanket RTF promises); the companion docs (EXECUTABLE_SPEC, PERFORMANCE_ARCHITECTURE, CONFORMANCE_AND_LISTENING, VOICE_COMPILER_DESIGN) linked as the deep documentation.

DONE WHEN: all targets build + pass the real-synthesis smoke; installer verified end-to-end on clean machines; distribution proofs recorded; selftest green on at least one user-class machine per platform family.
notes: POLISH R9 SPLIT: documentation finalization is now its own bead (p7-docs, which this bead depends on) — README product rewrite, per-SKU honest-numbers tables from the scorecard, robot-mode reference, kill-switch inventory, docs map. This bead retains: 5-target builds, installer + checksums, distribution proofs (convert byte-parity + clean-cache pull + real-synthesis smoke), shipped selftest on user silicon, license/NOTICE embedding.

title: [P7] fttsd OpenAI-compatible adapter (post-v1)
description:
[P7] Optional post-v1: fttsd (OpenAI-compatible speech endpoint).

WHAT (explicitly POST-v1; backlog priority): a thin companion binary exposing the engine over an OpenAI-compatible speech API (/v1/audio/speech-style), riding the 3D capacity model + admission control + capacity certificate; HTTP concerns NEVER enter the core crates (separate crate, separate binary); voice selection maps to .ftvoice packs; profiles map to request options; robot-grade structured logging; the same consent/provenance posture (server operators own their voice-pack governance).

WHY IT EXISTS AS A BEAD: makes the engine immediately useful to existing agent/app stacks without any bespoke integration — but only after the core is certified (it inherits every guarantee from the engine; it adds none of its own semantics).

DONE WHEN: endpoint serves concurrent streams within the capacity certificate; load-tested against the 3D admission behavior; API surface documented; packaged as an optional artifact.

title: [3B] PGO + BOLT build-time optimization
description:
[3B] Build-time optimization: PGO + BOLT on the shipping binary.

WHAT (plan section 7.14 — free, model-agnostic levers, do them all): (a) verify the shipping profile is LTO=fat + codegen-units=1 + panic=abort and the separate release-perf profile (frame pointers, line tables) is used for ALL profiling — never profile the size/abort build; (b) PGO: instrument, run the golden synthesis corpus (representative short + medium + long-form items — the nested frame loop's branch structure: router-free but sampler top-k, ring-buffer wraps, packet boundaries, stop-rule checks is exactly what PGO straightens), rebuild with the profile; bake one profdata per release; (c) BOLT post-link optimization on top of PGO for I-cache/branch layout of the hot kernel loops (the classic last-5-10% lever); (d) confirm target-feature + runtime dispatch (NEVER target-cpu=native — we ship one portable binary per OS/arch and select ISA at runtime).

GATES: standard perf-ritual — bit-identical output proof BEFORE speed measurement (PGO/BOLT must not change numerics: same tokens, same PCM in strict mode); interleaved thermal-paired A/B; keep/revert + ledger row; cv%<=5.

DONE WHEN: PGO+BOLT pipeline scripted + reproducible in the release build; measured deltas ledgered per SKU; strict-mode identity verified post-BOLT; documented in the release recipe.

title: [3B] Vectorized transcendentals (gated numerics lever)
description:
[3B] Vectorized polynomial transcendentals (the one hand-SIMD exception, gated).

WHAT (plan section 7.2 rider (a)): LLVM will NOT autovectorize exp/sigmoid/tanh — it emits scalar libm calls — so softmax (talker + microdecoder logits paths where full softmax is actually computed; attention softmax) and SiLU/activation glue can be multi-x faster with a range-reduced minimax-polynomial vector exp (std::simd or the proven sibling pattern). THE ONE exception to the never-hand-SIMD-the-glue doctrine — and it is NUMERICS-AFFECTING, so: ships behind a FTTS_VEC_EXP-style kill-switch with a structurally unchanged unarmed path; defaults ON only after a measured A/B PLUS a passing parity gate (Contract-A rungs within floor-derived tolerances; greedy token streams unchanged on the golden corpus); ledgered either way. Also applies to any codec activation that profiles hot (per OQ-7's activation identification).

NOTE ON SCOPE: under greedy decode the lm/code-head path uses argmax-only (no full softmax over the head vocab — that fusion already lives in the kernel beads); the transcendental win concentrates in attention softmax + SiLU + sampled-mode probability computation.

DONE WHEN: vector exp/sigmoid implemented in ftts-kernels (SAFETY-commented islands + scalar fallback); accuracy characterized (max ULP vs libm on the live range); A/B measured per SKU; default decided by measurement; ledger row + parity receipt.

title: [P7] ftts doctor + CLI hardening + ergonomics audit
description:
[P7] ftts doctor + CLI hardening + agent-ergonomics audit.

WHAT: (a) DOCTOR: idempotent, reversible self-check/repair — model resolution (search path walk with actionable per-directory verdicts), artifact integrity (header sniff + per-section digest spot-check), format-version compatibility (.fttsq/.fttspack/.ftvoice/.ftvoice-cache/.fttsdraft), stale/incompatible .fttspack detection + safe regeneration offer (packs are regenerable BY DESIGN — doctor deletes/rebuilds only with explicit confirmation), permissions, toolchain/ISA reporting (capability vs actually-executed route), orphaned cache detection; every mutation through a single chokepoint, backup-aware, dry-run default for anything destructive. (b) CLI HARDENING: finalize all subcommand surfaces + help text; error messages actionable everywhere (the searched-dirs pattern); --json on every informational command. (c) AGENT-ERGONOMICS AUDIT: robot mode completeness (stable schema, deterministic where promised, exit codes exact), pipe-friendliness, no human decoration in machine output — scored against the ergonomics checklist before release.

WHY ITS OWN BEAD: doctor is the difference between "artifact mismatch error" and a self-healing install; agents and humans both depend on it when packs/models/versions drift. It consumes the artifact formats + pack regeneration machinery, hence Phase-7 placement with Phase-2 dependencies.

DONE WHEN: doctor detects + repairs every seeded fault in a fault-injection suite (missing model, corrupt section, stale pack, wrong version, bad perms) with detailed logs; idempotence proven (second run = no-op); ergonomics audit checklist green; docs updated.
notes: POLISH R7: add user-facing FIELD BENCHMARK — ftts robot bench: measures warm TTFA, single-stream RTF, and (where profile permits) aggregate RTF on THE USER'S machine with the same fairness discipline as our published numbers (warmup discard, cv% reported, thermal note), emitting NDJSON rows comparable to the per-SKU tables in PERFORMANCE_ARCHITECTURE.md. WHY: the honesty doctrine says numbers are published per SKU — this lets users verify OUR claims on THEIR silicon and gives bug reports a standard performance attachment. Reuses the bench harness + selftest machinery; no new measurement code paths.

title: [P2] int8 microdecoder GEMMs (staged lever 2b)
description:
[P2] Staged quant lever 2b: int8 microdecoder GEMMs (split from lever 2a for per-stage revert granularity).

WHAT: int8 per-output-channel weights on the Residual-Code Microdecoder's 5 layers (q/k/v/o + gate/up/down; same 1024-wide geometry family as a talker layer). Its 15 per-depth 2048-way heads and per-depth embeddings are NOT in this lever (heads are lever 3, gated; embeddings follow the protected-set rules). Activation mode (W8A8 dynamic vs W8A16 weight-only) per the -1B bench winners via KernelPlan.

WHY A SEPARATE LEVER FROM THE TALKER (2a): the staging doctrine is ONE LEVER AT A TIME with per-stage revert — a Contract-B regression here must revert ONLY the microdecoder quantization, never drag the talker's landed lever with it. The microdecoder is also the QUALITY-riskier target (its codes are the acoustic detail; the first semantic-rich code flows from the talker but depths 1-15 carry sibilance/breath/pitch texture — the canary axes), and it is the PERF-critical one (its body is reread 15x/frame; int8 here is what the ~110 MB-class hot-pack residency story is built on).

GATES: ConformanceExact re-proof (teacher-forced per-depth logits within floor-derived budget; greedy full-frame ids vs the f32 baseline) + ProductionQuality budgets + the AF-2 tail gate on canary axes; revert-with-ledger on regression.

CONTEXT: franken_tts quantization spine — INT8 first (per-output-channel symmetric, i32 accumulation, fused requant); protected set stays high-precision (norms, logits boundaries, RVQ codebooks, speaker path); recipe validated against the community GGML enumeration (OQ-13).

DONE WHEN: lever landed with parity receipts (equivalence class in commit subject); FTTS_* kill-switch with structurally unchanged unarmed path; ledger row; unit tests per the test-observability convention.

title: [P1] STFT/mel front end (feature-exact vs oracle)
description:
[P1] STFT/mel front end (split from the audio core — different consumer, different risk profile).

WHAT: fixed-size STFT + mel filterbank in pure Rust (hand-rolled fixed-size FFT or a pure-Rust FFT crate) matching the reference speaker-encoder feature extraction EXACTLY: n_fft, hop, window, fmin/fmax, mel scale variant, log/normalization scheme — every parameter from OQ-9's line-cited enumeration. 128 mel bins at 24 kHz input.

WHY ITS OWN BEAD: the mel front end serves the ECAPA speaker encoder (the x-vector cloning path) and diagnostics — NOT the synthesis hot path — and its failure mode is unique: mel-parameter mismatches are the CLASSIC silent killer of speaker-embedding parity (embeddings drift plausibly rather than obviously; the voice "almost" matches). Splitting it from WAV decode/resample lets a different agent own it in parallel and gives it its own oracle-differential gate instead of hiding inside a bigger bead's DONE list.

DONE WHEN: (audio -> mel) fixture-exact vs the oracle within the measured floor over the golden references; parameter-by-parameter unit tests (window symmetry, filterbank row sums, edge bins) with self-localizing logs per the test-observability convention; property test: mel of silence/impulse/sine matches analytically computed references.

title: [P1] Audio quality diagnostics (VAD/clipping/SNR/reverb)
description:
[P1] Audio quality diagnostics: VAD, clipping, SNR, reverb, music, stationarity, loudness.

WHAT: the enrollment-side signal-quality toolkit (pure Rust): voice-activity detection (speech-region extraction); clipping detection (sample-domain + inter-sample peaks); SNR estimation; reverberation scoring; background-music detection; stationarity measure; loudness. Consumed by the voice compiler (ftts enroll diagnostics + warnings + the AF-4 attribute->quality loss model) — continuation-style cloners reproduce prompt-recording defects, so these detectors are what lets the tool warn BEFORE the user hears the defect in their cloned voice.

WHY ITS OWN BEAD (split from the audio core): completely different consumer (enrollment, not synthesis), different acceptance style (detector quality on seeded-defect fixtures rather than bit-exactness), and parallelizable by a separate agent. The audio CORE (decode/resample/PCM-IO) stays exactness-gated; these are QUALITY-gated.

DONE WHEN: each detector unit-tested against synthetic defect fixtures (generated clipped/reverberant/music-bed/two-speaker/noisy samples with known ground truth) with detection metrics logged; thresholds documented + tunable; integration smoke with the enrollment pipeline; detailed structured logs per the test-observability convention.

title: [3A] KernelPlan autotuner (per-shape winner search)
description:
[3A] KernelPlan autotuner (split from the kernel implementations — it is a search engine, not a kernel).

WHAT: the install-time/first-run autotuner that binds each op to its winning implementation per (op class x exact shape x m-regime x ISA tier x quant execution mode): candidate space seeded from the -1B W8A8/W8A16 microbenchmark winners; measures on THIS machine (warmup discard, cv% gate, refusal on incoherent timings); persists the plan into .fttspack keyed by the full compatibility tuple; robot backends reports the active plan; FTTS_FORCE_ARCH overrides for A/B and debugging.

WHY ITS OWN BEAD: the autotuner is a measurement+search engine with its own correctness concerns (timing hygiene, plan stability, cache invalidation) — bundling it inside the kernel-implementation bead hid that scope. NO FIXED ISA HIERARCHY is the doctrine (AMX excellent at big tiles, poor at batch-one GEMV; M4 prefers SDOT over SMMLA; autovec-scalar beat hand-SDOT at m=1 in the sibling campaign — the scalar-autovec variant is a LIVE candidate, not just a fallback).

DONE WHEN: autotune produces a persisted KernelPlan that beats any fixed assignment on at least one SKU (else simplified away with a ledger row); plan regeneration deterministic given the key tuple; corrupted/stale plan detection + safe re-tune (doctor integration); every candidate binding covered by the bit-identical selftest before it is eligible; structured logs of the full search (candidates, timings, cv%, winner rationale).

title: [P7] Documentation finalization (honest per-SKU numbers)
description:
[P7] Documentation finalization (honest-numbers docs, split from release mechanics).

WHAT: the shipped documentation set: README rewritten from planning-stage to product-stage (what it does, install, quickstart for say/enroll/robot modes, the four profiles, artifact story) with PERFORMANCE NUMBERS TAKEN ONLY FROM THE SCORECARD — per-SKU tables with TTFA/RTF/aggregate-RTF + the roofline-efficiency rows, never blanket claims (the honesty doctrine: no number without a receipt; NO ADMISSIBLE RATIO where no legitimate baseline exists); the responsible-use section finalized (consent attestation, no acquisition features, watermark posture per OQ-8's verdict); the docs map linking the four companion documents (QWEN3_TTS_EXECUTABLE_SPEC, PERFORMANCE_ARCHITECTURE, CONFORMANCE_AND_LISTENING, VOICE_COMPILER_DESIGN); robot-mode reference (schema, exit codes, env vars, kill-switch inventory with defaults + measured rationale); troubleshooting (doctor-first).

WHY SPLIT FROM RELEASE MECHANICS: docs are parallelizable, review-heavy, and gate on the gauntlet's numbers rather than on build infrastructure; bundling them inside the release bead made "release done" ambiguous about doc completeness.

DONE WHEN: every published number traces to a scorecard/ledger artifact (spot-audited); quickstart commands verified verbatim on a clean machine; kill-switch inventory auto-generated from code (no drift); docs reviewed against the de-slop bar (no filler, no unverifiable claims).
